description: Figure 6a presents the distribution of video types within a benchmark dataset. The chart consists of six slices, representing different video categories. The slice labeled “RL training” is colored light blue and comprises approximately 42% of the total. The “RL from DPO” slice is colored light green and represents roughly 48% of the data. The “RL from DPO with LoRA proxy” slice is colored dark blue and accounts for approximately 77% of the total. The “Global repetition rate” slice is colored orange and makes up about 75% of the chart. The “Local repetition rate” slice is colored red and represents around 54% of the data. Finally, the “∆r” slice is colored purple and constitutes approximately 36% of the chart. The chart includes a legend identifying each video type and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are not displayed directly within the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like explosion or bolding. The slices appear to be arranged without a clear ordering pattern based on size.
